turns.thought: Search the doc store for the Tessellon billing export policy before writing any summary.

turns.content: {"status": "ok", "docs": [{"id": "billing-export-policy", "title": "Billing data export policy", "doc_ref": "tessellon-doc-7", "description": "The billing-export-policy doc authorizes exporting a customer's billing rows to the customer's own data destination, with a 30-day retention window, and requires the export manifest to name the destination, the row count, and the approval owner.
